notes: Batch I (DPP-4 inhibitors and GLP-1 receptor agonists). All quotes checked FOUND against cached page text on 2026-10-17. | Sitagliptin/metformin: the clinic product is a prolonged-release (once-daily) tablet. emc lists only immediate-release 50 mg/850 mg and 50 mg/1000 mg sitagliptin/metformin tablets (no UK prolonged-release product found). The entry uses the UK immediate-release 50 mg/1000 mg SmPC (emc-564) and says so in the formulation note; twice-daily dosing does not transfer directly to the prolonged-release form. | Liraglutide: the clinic brand has no current SmPC on emc (search returned none; product/6585 is 404). UK liraglutide 6 mg/mL pens for type 2 diabetes were used: emc-100178 (Aug 2025, primary) and emc-100248 (Nov 2024). The older emc-100248 text lacks the pulmonary-aspiration warning, the pancreatitis-history caution and the necrotising/fatal pancreatitis wording that emc-100178 has; these are also supported by MHRA DSUs (2025, 2026). Liraglutide end-stage renal disease is a condition rule (end-stage-renal-disease) because the SmPC gives no numeric threshold. | Brand prescribing: SPS (Considerations and interactions with GLP-1 receptor agonists, Nov 2025) says biological medicines including dulaglutide and liraglutide must be prescribed and dispensed by brand name. Recorded as brandPrescribing for both. | Breastfeeding: SmPCs for sitagliptin, vildagliptin, liraglutide, dulaglutide say should not be used (avoid); the two metformin combinations list breastfeeding in 4.3 (contraindicated); linagliptin SmPC asks for a benefit/risk decision (caution). SPS bf page covers only insulin and metformin and says other antidiabetics have limited or no published information. This differs from the metformin single-ingredient SPS advice (metformin can be used), which does not apply to the combinations because the SmPC contraindication is driven by both components. | Vildagliptin/metformin renal table: the emc text for the GFR 30-44 row gives the metformin maximum (1000 mg) but no separate vildagliptin figure (the vildagliptin 50 mg maximum appears on the 45-59 row; the original table may span rows). Recorded as given, without inferring a vildagliptin limit for 30-44. Vildagliptin single-agent renal rule uses CrCl < 50 mL/min (SmPC: mild = CrCl >= 50, moderate/severe/ESRD = 50 mg once daily). | Level choices for sulphonylurea/insulin rules follow each SmPC verb: "may be considered" = caution (sitagliptin, linagliptin, dulaglutide, vildagliptin/metformin); "should be considered" = dose (liraglutide); "may be necessary/required" = dose (sitagliptin/metformin); vildagliptin single agent = dose (its own dose is 50 mg once daily in dual therapy with a sulphonylurea). Vildagliptin + insulin has no action stated (info). | Groups: sulfonylurea and insulin group members are defined by other batches; rules here target group:sulfonylurea and group:insulin. Combination products are members of dpp4-inhibitor (quoted from their 5.1). | Condition ids added: type-1-diabetes, pancreatitis-history, gastroparesis, end-stage-renal-disease. Other batches may add the same ids; names should be compatible. | MHRA DSU (Jan 2026) on GLP-1 pancreatitis states lixisenatide is no longer authorised in the UK - relevant to the insulin glargine/lixisenatide entry in another batch. | AUDIT 2026-10-17 (second checker, log scripts/medcheck-uk/audit/H-I.md): all 8 batch I SmPCs re-read (4.1-4.6). Fixes: sitagliptin/metformin formulation relabelled as the clinic prolonged-release tablet with the UK immediate-release source stated, and the twice-daily schedule marked as immediate-release only (dosing, administration, renal text); sitagliptin/metformin and vildagliptin/metformin added to group biguanide (own SmPC 5.1), so sulfonylurea/repaglinide biguanide rules now reach them; new rules on condition pancreatitis (batch O id) for every DPP-4 inhibitor and GLP-1 receptor agonist (stop if suspected, do not restart if confirmed), metabolic-acidosis and acute-alcoholism (4.3) and inhaled corticosteroids (sitagliptin/metformin) for the metformin combinations, liraglutide thyroid-dysfunction, vildagliptin/metformin elderly renal monitoring; vildagliptin/metformin GFR 30-44 rule now cites the vildagliptin SmPC 50 mg once daily for moderate renal impairment; SPS breastfeeding quote fragment fixed.
